headline: IQM reports a vision-language workflow calibrating all 20 qubits on one processor
summary: IQM's Oct. 21 case study reports connecting NVIDIA Ising Calibration vision-language models to IQM calibration software and running the workflow on one 20-qubit processor. IQM says the system widened measurement ranges for qubits whose settings fell outside chart ranges, reran those measurements and finished with all 20 qubits calibrated. The report provides no calibration-quality metric, elapsed time, matched expert baseline or independent reproduction, so it supports an attributed account of one run rather than a performance or generalization result.
